source_licence_note: Official public PROJ/OSGeo and pyproj documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: PROJ projinfo operation summary
official_sources.finding: projinfo can enumerate candidate operations and summarize name, accuracy and area of use.

official_sources.title: PROJ projinfo grid-check
official_sources.finding: grid-check can sort, discard missing grids or require grids known available through local resources/CDN.

official_sources.title: PROJ projinfo ballpark filtering
official_sources.finding: projinfo exposes hide-ballpark/accuracy/AOI controls so terminal operation selection can fail closed.

official_sources.title: PROJ projinfo superseded/pivot controls
official_sources.finding: superseded operations and pivot-CRS policy are explicit query choices and must be serialized.

official_sources.title: pyproj Transformer accuracy/area
official_sources.finding: Transformer exposes expected accuracy and area of use; unknown accuracy is reported as -1.

official_sources.title: pyproj always_xy axis policy
official_sources.finding: always_xy changes interface ordering to traditional GIS x,y; CRS native axis order otherwise remains authoritative.

official_sources.title: pyproj only_best / allow_ballpark
official_sources.finding: only_best can error if the best known usable operation is unavailable; allow_ballpark=False disallows approximate ballpark operations.

official_sources.title: pyproj TransformerGroup ordering
official_sources.finding: TransformerGroup exposes candidate operations sorted by relevance/accuracy and whether best_available is true.

official_sources.title: pyproj missing-grid diagnosis
official_sources.finding: TransformerGroup exposes unavailable operations and missing grid names/URLs, enabling explicit grid remediation rather than silent fallback.

official_sources.title: pyproj last-used operation
official_sources.finding: get_last_used_operation returns the actual operation selected for a transform call.

official_sources.title: PROJ coordinate-operation filtering
official_sources.finding: operation filtering considers desired accuracy, area of use and missing-grid policy before relevance sorting.

official_sources.title: PROJ ballpark definition
official_sources.finding: ballpark transformations omit a true datum shift and have unknown accuracy that can reach tens or hundreds of metres.

official_sources.title: PROJ network capability
official_sources.finding: PROJ_NETWORK controls remote grid loading; endpoint and local cache behavior are configurable and must be logged.

official_sources.title: PROJ resource-file search paths
official_sources.finding: PROJ searches explicit paths, configured file finders and data directories for database/grid resources.

official_sources.title: PROJ projsync resource selection
official_sources.finding: projsync can select transformation resources by bbox, spatial test, source id, area of use or filename.

official_sources.title: pyproj grid sync inventory
official_sources.finding: pyproj.sync can list downloadable grids by bbox/source/area and distinguish already-downloaded resources.

official_sources.title: pyproj transformation-grid packaging
official_sources.finding: pyproj wheels do not include transformation grids; grid availability must be verified independently.

official_sources.title: PROJ pipeline step model
official_sources.finding: pipeline steps are ordered operations and adjacent step units must be compatible.

official_sources.title: PROJ unit conversion
official_sources.finding: unitconvert explicitly handles linear, angular and temporal units including decimal years.

official_sources.title: PROJ axis swap
official_sources.finding: axisswap explicitly changes axis order/sign and should be visible when used.

official_sources.title: PROJ axis-order FAQ
official_sources.finding: PROJ respects authority-defined CRS axis order; projinfo/WKT can be used to inspect it.

official_sources.title: PROJ cs2cs dynamic epochs
official_sources.finding: cs2cs supports source/target coordinate epochs for dynamic CRS and CRS@epoch syntax.

official_sources.title: PROJ cs2cs 3D vertical gate
official_sources.finding: from PROJ 9.1 both CRS need 3D promotion for a vertical transformation to be possible in relevant cases.

official_sources.title: PROJ cct 4D replay
official_sources.finding: cct is a 4D transform tool and can fix observation time/height explicitly for reproducible replay.

official_sources.title: PROJ coordinate metadata epochs
official_sources.finding: PROJ 9.2 accepts coordinate metadata epochs on one side and 9.4 supports both sides for epoch changes in supported dynamic-CRS cases.

official_sources.title: PROJ generic transform axis/time
official_sources.finding: proj_trans_generic respects CRS axis ordering and supports x,y,z,t arrays; missing time arrays become zero and constants are modified in place.

official_sources.title: PROJ last-used operation C API
official_sources.finding: proj_trans_get_last_used_operation reports the operation actually used when several alternatives exist.

official_sources.title: PROJ horizontal temporal grid shift
official_sources.finding: hgridshift supports temporal step behavior; @-prefixed grids are optional and therefore unsuitable for silent terminal fallback.

official_sources.title: PROJ vertical grid shift
official_sources.finding: vgridshift prioritizes grids by list order and applies an explicit multiplier; time-dependent shifts use observation/final epochs.

official_sources.title: PROJ general grid shift
official_sources.finding: general gridshift can alter horizontal and vertical components and defines interpolation behavior from grid metadata/options.

official_sources.title: PROJ Helmert kinematic transform
official_sources.finding: kinematic Helmert transforms require observation time plus transformation epoch when rate terms are used.

official_sources.title: PROJ deformation model
official_sources.finding: deformation operations are 4D and use time plus velocity/deformation grids; epoch provenance is part of the coordinate.

official_sources.title: pyproj AreaOfInterest
official_sources.finding: AreaOfInterest/AreaOfUse expose explicit geographic bounds used for operation selection and containment/intersection checks.

official_sources.title: pyproj CoordinateOperation flags
official_sources.finding: CoordinateOperation exposes whether an operation is instantiable and whether it contains a ballpark transformation.
